title: Tool Use (Function Calling)

body.text: — define a tool with a schema for what parameters it takes, and when Claude sees it's needed, it sends a call request with the correct values.

example: "Tool: get_weather(city) → user asks 'will it rain in Chiang Mai tomorrow?' → Claude calls get_weather('Chiang Mai') and answers from real data"

title: Design tools Claude uses well

body.text: clear description — what the tool does, when to use it, and what the parameters mean
. Claude chooses tools based on this description; if it's vague, it'll call the wrong one or not call at all.

example: "Good: 'Search products by name or SKU, returns price and stock, use when a customer asks about a product' / Bad: 'search stuff'"
